evidence.reason: The README's claim that the `full` charge covers post-settle folds from a detached op is inaccurate. Settlement charges `max(r, folded)` using evidence available at settle; later folds are suppressed at the runner, so additional post-settle spend can exceed that charge and cannot trigger a breach. The following normal-settle residual describes a distinct case.
